detections.evidence_quote: published exclusively on our private subscriber-only podcast feed
detections.summary: Host pitches the paid subscriber feed and asks listeners to subscribe.

detections.evidence_quote: if you could actually measure some things for longevity
detections.summary: Host discusses how well blood tests can measure longevity and lifespan through cardiovascular, cancer and neurodegenerative risk.

detections.evidence_quote: what you're not going to get on a standard blood test is any of the longevity genes
detections.summary: Diagnostic tools for longevity risk: standard blood tests, CT angiograms, calcium scores and liquid biopsies.

detections.evidence_quote: Cardiovascular disease largely driven by three things: lipoproteins, inflammation, endothelial dysfunction
detections.summary: Blood markers for cardiovascular risk: Lp(a), LDL particle number, VLDL, inflammation markers, endothelial function and insulin.

detections.evidence_quote: What is this person's risk of neurodegenerative disease
detections.summary: Neurodegenerative disease is named as one of the three disease risks to assess in blood.

detections.evidence_quote: The older a patient gets, the more I would probably rely on things like CT angiograms
detections.summary: Age-dependent use of CT angiograms and calcium scores for cardiovascular risk, with non-calcified lesions noted.

detections.evidence_quote: virtually every cancer is a result of a somatic mutation, not a germline mutation
detections.summary: Cancer risk from blood tests, liquid biopsies and genotype, including somatic mutations and BRCA/Lynch exceptions.

detections.evidence_quote: James O'Keefe just recently was on a paper that looked at cardiovascular health in patients with type 1 diabetes
detections.summary: James O'Keefe paper on insulin dose and cardiovascular health in type 1 diabetes is cited.

detections.evidence_quote: the way I tell patients is, the younger you are, the more your blood tells me about your risk of cardiovascular disease
detections.summary: Host cites his patient-care experience for age-based interpretation of blood tests.

detections.evidence_quote: the latest study I saw, which actually just was an editorial that came out two days ago, based on a study in one of the atherosclerosis journals
detections.summary: A recent study/editorial on non-calcified lesions is invoked without identifying the journal.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The lower your LP little A, the greater your chance of cardiovascular mortality.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: the lower your LP little A, the greater your chance of cardiovascular mortality
verification_candidates.rationale: An inverse relationship between Lp(a) and cardiovascular mortality is a checkable claim that affects how listeners interpret the biomarker.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Cardiovascular disease is largely driven by three things: lipoproteins, inflammation, endothelial dysfunction.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Cardiovascular disease largely driven by three things: lipoproteins, inflammation, endothelial dysfunction
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim about the main drivers of cardiovascular disease.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Insulin is toxic at high levels to the endothelium.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I think that insulin is, in and of itself, actually toxic at high levels to the endothelium
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about insulin's direct toxicity to the endothelium that could affect how listeners view insulin levels.

verification_candidates.claim_text: ADMA and SDMA are inhibitors of nitric oxide synthase.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: asymmetric dimethylarginine, or ADMA, and SDMA, which are inhibitors of nitric oxide synthase
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable biochemical claim used to explain a cardiovascular risk marker.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Fifty percent of patients that had events had them at the site of non-calcified lesions.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: looking at fifty percent of patients that had that had events had them at the site. Of non-calcified lesions
verification_candidates.rationale: A quantified finding about where cardiovascular events occur relative to calcified lesions, relevant to calcium-score usefulness.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Virtually every cancer is a result of a somatic mutation, not a germline mutation.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: virtually every cancer is a result of a somatic mutation, not a germline mutation
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim about cancer origins that affects whether genetic testing is useful.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Knowing your genotype doesn't really help, outside of a few outlier things like BRCA or Lynch.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: knowing your genotype doesn't really help, outside of a few outlier things like BRCA or Lynch
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about the utility of genetic testing for cancer risk, with named exceptions.
